name: Jonathan Berry
summary: Jonathan Berry is the Labor Department’s chief legal officer. Confirmed by the Senate on October 7, 2025, and sworn in on November 5, he had been managing partner of the law firm Boyden Gray PLLC, and wrote the Labor Department chapter of the Heritage Foundation’s Project 2025. In the first Trump administration he was principal deputy assistant secretary for policy at Labor, heading its regulatory office, after serving in the Justice Department’s Office of Legal Policy.
